newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines increases rate on loans to exporters.
newsitem.headline: Philippines increases rate on loans to exporters.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Monday it was raising the interest rate on loans to exporters by 0.25 percentage points to an annual 5.6875 percent, with immediate effect.
The rate is adjusted every three months based on the prevailing three-month London interbank offered rate.
Banks can lend the money to exporters at a spread of no more than one percentage point.
